analysis.title: GS Vol Views 14 Oct 2026
key_insights: Poor sentiment and low net exposures leave investors hesitant to play offense. GS flows have a defensive tilt and skew has steepened on downside demand, but the options complex shows limited panic overall: the desk's Vol Panic Index reads 2.7/10.
Going into a catalyst-heavy stretch (3Q earnings, FOMC, Midterms), GS says gamma and vol both screen cheap and expects clients to engage more tactically.
Earnings from about 7% of S&P market cap and macro data (PPI, Retail Sales) arrive before the end of the week. The implied move through Friday is only 0.76%.
3m implied correlation sits below the 2nd percentile of the last twenty years, so options price considerable dispersion through year-end.

The GS cash desk flagged consecutive days of Generalist/long-only outflows from AI/Memory. The derivatives desk saw several restructurings of prior bullish options positions, including SKHY 20Nov26 195/225 call spreads rolled down-and-in to SKHY 30Oct26 175/195 call spreads (20k around).

GS PB data shows net exposure to Mag7 constituents in the 100th percentile vs the last 5 years, while average 3-month implied vol is approaching multi-year lows. GS likes puts on its Mag7 basket as a hedge through earnings and year-end.
Flight to quality: GSP1QUAL is +18% since mid-August and PB data shows exposure to the factor has broken to 10-year highs.

SPX 10-day realized vol is 7.2 and dealer gamma is near peak levels at spot, which has pushed the cost of short-dated gamma lower. Tuesday, the first day of 3Q earnings, had the lowest SPX 1-day implied move YTD.
QQQ 1m ATM vol is around 18, which GS calls aggressively compressed. GS likes outright QQQ calls through Nov 6 to capture catalysts, with earnings from 78% of SPX market cap, FOMC and Midterms.

With duration catching a multi-day bid, GS fielded interest in relief trades across rate-sensitive areas (IWM, TLT, ITB). GS Investment Research noted yields are elevated relative to macro fundamentals, positioning is underweight and technical risks have faded, which should leave US duration better supported.

Light exotics ideas: a dual digital on SPXXAI and 10y SOFR for a catch-up in market participation if rates compress, a worst-of call basket offering SPX-like convexity at a discount to vanilla, and a defense vs industrials dispersion Palladium.

Market structure: from Monday Oct 19, 2026 Cboe Options (C1) and NYSE American Options introduce extended hours (pre-market 7:30-9:25 AM ET, post-market 4:00-4:15 PM ET) for 29 eligible single-stock and ETF options tickers.
